name: Ask your data
summary: Answers the owner's questions about the business's own data (cash, profit, who owes what) from Xero, a fixed Power BI query and the numbers pack. Crons read and draft; the owner gets each answer only after a person approves the send.

covered_by.pull-data: draft (Xero reports and invoices, Power BI query, numbers pack rows)
covered_by.build-report: draft (answer built from the latest figures)
covered_by.answer-owner: approval (the send waits for a person)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (questions and answers held in the store)

crons.name: pull-figures
crons.summary: Read the configured figures into one snapshot (19:00 UTC is 5 or 6 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: read-questions
crons.summary: Pick up new questions from the owner's address. Nothing is answered here.

crons.name: answer-questions
crons.summary: Draft each new answer to the owner from the latest snapshot, then queue its send for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads, a DAX query, and an Outlook draft to the owner only. The one send is a live operation and waits for a person.
gaps: The platform choice follows the kit's mapping. Xero, Power BI and Microsoft 365 have adapters here; Shopify needs its GraphQL shopifyql adapter, and Google Workspace, Sync Hub, Deputy, ShiftCare, ELMO, Style Arcade and Buildxact are not used by this job's adapters.
Power BI's executeQueries is a POST that the kit classes as a write, so the cron needs KIT_ALLOW_WRITES=1 on the deploy. A readPost review in core would remove that need, but core is not edited here.

Every adapter is docs-only: Xero, Power BI and Microsoft 365 are status spec in the kit, and each needs a sign-in (Xero refresh flow, a Power BI access token, a Graph access token) before any cron runs live.
Xero needs the accounting.reports.read and invoices scopes on the connected app.
The invoices list reads the first 100 authorised receivables only. Aged debtors by customer need a contact list step that is not built.
Questions are answered from fixed figure sets. Reading a question's meaning, choosing a new query and explaining a figure stay with a person and the SKILL.md steps.
